_note: Supply chain traces, ordered from the reactor back to the mine. 'stages' are shared by every route; 'routes' split the chain where there is more than one source. A lens annotation of null renders as 'Not yet researched for this lens'. sourceNeeded:true renders a visible 'Source needed' flag. 'rating' drives node colour only: supply = supply risk (security lens), harm = harm severity (people lens). Values: high | moderate | low | unknown. Ratings are the author's judgement and should be reviewed.

documented.label: Documented
documented.meaning: Credible public evidence (NGO, UN, government, peer-reviewed) of human rights harm at this stage

likely.label: Likely pathway
likely.meaning: Harm at the source is documented; the link from that source into fusion's supply chain is plausible by market structure but not proven

hypothesis.label: Hypothesis
hypothesis.meaning: A link worth testing; no direct evidence yet

yttrium.name: Yttrium
yttrium.role: The rare earth in REBCO superconducting tape

whyItMatters.text: Compact tokamaks use high-temperature superconducting magnets made from REBCO tape ("rare-earth barium copper oxide"). The rare earth is usually yttrium and cannot easily be substituted. Some makers use gadolinium instead, with yttrium oxide in the buffer layers beneath it.

stages.name: Compact tokamak developers (e.g. Commonwealth Fusion Systems)

security.text: Compact tokamak developers depend on HTS tape. CFS buys from Fujikura (an order for over 10,000 km in 2026) and Faraday Factory Japan. Russian customs records also show coated Hastelloy tape (oxide, silver and copper layers) exported from Moscow to CFS in January–April 2022.

people.text: Buyers sit several tiers removed from the mine. No public human rights traceability for magnet materials was found.

sayari.name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems LLC
sayari.basis: Russian customs: 9 export records of coated Hastelloy C276 tape from S-Innovations to CFS, Jan–Apr 2022.

security.text: A small number of makers supply fusion: Fujikura and Faraday Factory Japan (CFS), and Faraday Factory (Proxima Fusion). Sayari shows Faraday Factory Japan importing coated Hastelloy tape from Moscow until January 2025, some described with yttrium-containing oxide layers.

people.text: Sayari shows no yttrium oxide or yttrium targets reaching any tape maker. Japan publishes no shipment-level import data, so the step into Japanese tape makers cannot be seen.

sayari.name: Fujikura Ltd.
sayari.role: Tape maker; CFS's main supplier for ARC
sayari.basis: No HTS tape or yttrium shipments recorded.
sayari.watchlist: Not sanctioned. Group-level modelled flags come from its wider cable trade, not HTS tape.

sayari.name: Faraday Factory Japan LLC
sayari.role: Tape maker; supplies CFS and Proxima Fusion
sayari.basis: 369 shipments received from Russia, Feb 2023 – Jan 2025, e.g. 'Hastelloy C276 alloy tape with Mg, Cu, Ba, Y oxide layers'.

sayari.name: OOO S-Innovatsii (S-Innovations LLC)
sayari.role: Moscow tape maker in the SuperOx group (per public reporting)
sayari.basis: Exported coated tape to CFS (2022) and to Faraday Factory Japan (2023–25). INN 5032242530.
sayari.watchlist: Not sanctioned. Flags: imports_bis_high_priority_items, sanctioned_adjacent (trade adjacency only).

security.text: China added yttrium to export licensing in April 2025; US-bound yttrium exports collapsed afterwards.

stages.name: Heavy rare earth separation, China (and Lynas, Malaysia)

security.text: Separation of heavy rare earths, including yttrium, is overwhelmingly in China. Sayari records Jiangxi and Fujian separators shipping yttrium oxide to Japanese trading houses in 2022, and Lynas (Malaysia), a non-Chinese separator, shipping rare earth compounds to Korea in 2025–26. None is recorded selling to a tape maker.

people.text: Ore from Myanmar enters Chinese separation plants and leaves as Chinese product. Origin is lost here.

sayari.basis: 1 shipment HS 284690 'yttrium oxide' to Shinwa Bussan (Japan), 2022-04.

sayari.name: Quannan Advanced Resource Rare Earths
sayari.basis: 1 shipment HS 284690 'yttrium oxide' to Shinwa Bussan (Japan), 2022-04.

sayari.name: Fujian Changting Golden Dragon Rare Earth
sayari.basis: 1 shipment HS 284690 'yttrium oxide' to Mitsubishi International, 2022-10.

sayari.basis: 12 shipments HS 284690 to Korean buyers, 2025-06 to 2026-01; none a known tape maker.
sayari.watchlist: Not sanctioned. Its forced-labour and SOE flags are modelled sub-tier indicators, not findings about its operations.

stages.name: Kachin State, Myanmar

security.text: Myanmar is a significant yttrium source via ionic clays.

people.text: 300+ mining sites in militia-controlled Kachin Special Region 1 (40%+ growth 2021–23); acidic, arsenic-contaminated streams; health harms to workers and residents, including deaths; deadly landslides; the trade risks financing conflict.

stages.evidenceNote: Published investigations focus on dysprosium and terbium; yttrium-specific tracing to tape was not found. Sayari holds no Myanmar-to-China rare earth trade records, so this stage rests on NGO and press sources.

security.text: The main source.

people.text: Severe environmental damage from heavy rare earth mining in Jiangxi: a multi-billion-dollar cleanup, decades to recover.

yttrium.bottomLine: The magnets at the heart of compact fusion depend on yttrium separated overwhelmingly in China, where ore from militia-controlled Kachin State is mixed in and its origin lost. Sayari confirms who makes the tape and that part of it ran through Moscow until 2025, but no record shows where any tape maker's yttrium comes from. Harm at Kachin is documented; the link into fusion magnets is likely, not proven.

nickel.name: Nickel
nickel.role: The alloy backing (Hastelloy C-276) that REBCO tape is built on

whyItMatters.text: REBCO tape is built on thin strip of Hastelloy C-276, a nickel-chromium-molybdenum alloy. Specialty mills market this strip directly to tape makers.

security.text: CFS buys tape from Faraday Factory Japan and Fujikura. Russian customs records in Sayari show two flows with Moscow's S-Innovations group: coated Hastelloy tape exported to CFS in January–April 2022 (9 records), and uncoated Hastelloy C-276 tape exported by CFS to Moscow from May 2022 to December 2024 (15 records), declared 'for own use for research purposes'.

sayari.role: Recorded shipper of Hastelloy C276 tape to Moscow
sayari.basis: Russian customs: 11 HS 750620 imports from CFS by S-Innovations (2022-05 to 2024-12) and 4 by SuperOx-Innovations (2023-04 to 2023-10); 9 exports of coated tape from S-Innovations to CFS (2022-01 to 2022-04).

security.text: A major REBCO tape supplier to fusion developers. Japanese import records show it received 369 shipments from Moscow in 2023–25, 327 of them Hastelloy C-276 tape already carrying oxide buffer, silver and copper layers.

sayari.name: Faraday Factory Japan LLC
sayari.basis: 369 shipments received, all from Russia (2023-02 to 2025-01).

security.text: A Moscow company coats Hastelloy tape for Faraday Factory Japan. It buys the bare alloy tape from CFS and from at least six Chinese mills and traders. Sayari flags it for importing items on the US BIS high-priority list; it is not itself sanctioned.

sayari.role: Coats Hastelloy tape; ships it to Faraday Factory Japan
sayari.basis: INN 5032242530; same tax ID as SuperOx-Innovations.

sayari.name: OOO SuperOx-Innovatsii
sayari.role: Same operation, recorded under a second name
sayari.basis: 77 received shipments, including 4 from CFS (2023).

security.text: VDM Metals (Germany) and Elgiloy (US) market C-276 strip as tape substrate. Russian import records show Chinese mills also supplying it.

people.text: Nickel from many mines is melted together here. Sayari shows no Indonesian supplier upstream of Haynes International or VDM, and the Chinese mills have no upstream data at all.

sayari.basis: Nickel-filtered upstream supply chain: 0 results.

people.text: Indonesia's human rights commission (Komnas HAM, 2026) found the state failed to protect rights around Morowali, with rising respiratory illness. Fatal smelter accidents. Land grabs affecting Indigenous communities at Weda Bay.

evidence.scope: link to fusion: no Sayari path found

sayari.name: Indonesia Morowali Industrial Park
sayari.basis: Resolved only; no link to the substrate chain found.

nickel.bottomLine: Sayari did not confirm the Indonesia hypothesis: no path links tape substrate to Morowali or Weda Bay. It found a different route instead. Hastelloy tape from the US and China is coated in Moscow and shipped to a Japanese maker that supplies fusion developers.

tin.name: Tin

security.text: ITER's toroidal-field coils used about 500 t of Nb₃Sn strand, made in 2008–2015 by eight suppliers across six ITER members.

ITER's strand came from Bruker EAS (Germany), Bruker OST (US), JASTEC and SH Copper (Japan), Kiswire Advanced Technology (South Korea), Luvata, Western Superconducting Technologies (China) and Chepetsky Mechanical Plant (Russia). Sayari lists Chepetsky on Ukraine's NSDC sanctions list and records Western Superconducting as owned by a Chinese state-owned enterprise.

people.text: Sayari holds no niobium or tin shipments into any of these strand makers, so where their metal comes from cannot be traced from trade data.

evidence.scope: where their tin and niobium come from

routes.name: Man Maw, Wa State → Yunnan smelters

security.text: Wa State has no smelters; ore goes to smelters in Yunnan, China. The largest, Yunnan Tin, is state-owned according to Sayari's registry data.

people.text: Origin is lost at smelting. Sayari holds no Myanmar-to-China tin ore records, so this flow cannot be shown from trade data.

sayari.basis: Registry: USCC 915300007134002589. No Myanmar ore receipts recorded.
sayari.watchlist: Owned by a Chinese state-owned enterprise; regulatory_action flag.

security.text: Myanmar was the world's 3rd-largest tin producer, nearly all of it from Man Maw. The mine restarted in 2025–26 after a suspension.

people.text: Controlled by the United Wa State Army, a non-state armed group under US sanctions since 2003 (narcotics trafficking). Access is tightly restricted.

sayari.role: Armed group controlling the Man Maw area
sayari.basis: Its Sayari network holds sanctioned individuals and Hong Pang companies; no tin traders or smelters.
sayari.watchlist: On the US OFAC sanctions list (SDN 7825).

security.text: A second tin smelting hub. It receives tin concentrate shipped from Tanzania by international metals traders, and one recorded lot from Myeik, southern Myanmar (November 2025). Sayari links it at one hop to Star Dragon Corporation, a Hong Kong trader on the US OFAC sanctions list; the goods behind that link were not retrieved.

people.text: Origin is lost at smelting. The Tanzania-shipped concentrate's mine of origin is not stated in the records.

context.label: Sector-wide
context.text: Tin is rated the highest-risk of the conflict minerals for labour abuses. Child labour is rated "extreme risk" in Myanmar, Indonesia and Bolivia.

tin.bottomLine: Fusion's Nb₃Sn strand makers are known, but Sayari shows no tin going into any of them. Upstream, Myanmar tin from a mine run by a US-sanctioned armed group disappears into Chinese smelters, and a second smelter in Malaysia buys from traders who also handle Rwanda's conflict-linked coltan. The harm is documented; the route into fusion is not traced.

tungsten.bottomLine: Only a handful of firms make fusion-grade tungsten, and China mines about four-fifths of the world's supply. Sayari shows a Western powder maker buying ore through a trader that also handles Rwandan tungsten, but nothing ties conflict-linked ore to a fusion part.

lithium6.name: Lithium-6
lithium6.role: Enriched lithium for breeding tritium fuel

security.text: There is effectively no commercial supply. Only Russia and China are known to produce enriched lithium, and it is export-controlled because of its weapons use. In March 2026 US start-up Molten Salt Solutions signed supply agreements with Type One Energy and Gauss Fusion.

people.text: The legacy enrichment process uses mercury. That is the process behind the Oak Ridge contamination below.

US lithium enrichment at Oak Ridge used mercury. About 1.1 million kg was lost on site, around 10% of it into East Fork Poplar Creek. About 15 miles of the creek still exceed mercury water-quality criteria.

lithium6.bottomLine: Fusion's fuel chain has caused harm before: lithium-6 enrichment at Oak Ridge left mercury in a creek that still exceeds water-quality criteria. Today there is no commercial supply outside Russia and China, and new enrichers are only now signing deals with fusion developers.

beryllium.name: Beryllium

security.text: Has a supply agreement with Materion for beryllium fluoride. Sayari does not show it, which is expected for a domestic US sale.

sayari.name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems LLC
sayari.basis: SEC CIK 0001744079. No beryllium suppliers among its recorded imports.

security.text: Supply is concentrated among a few producers. Ulba is owned by the Kazakh state through Kazatomprom and Samruk-Kazyna (Sayari registry data); Sayari flags it for regulatory action and for imports from a US-sanctioned trader. Kazakhstan supplied 31% of US beryllium imports in 2021–24.

people.text: The main people risk is worker health. Chronic beryllium disease is a lung disease caused by breathing beryllium dust or fumes, and OSHA calls it the primary health risk for beryllium workers.

stages.name: Beryllium ore: US (Utah), Brazil, China, Nigeria

security.text: The US mined 230 of the world's roughly 430 t of beryllium in 2025; about 60% of identified resources are at Spor Mountain, Utah.

beryllium.bottomLine: Beryllium supply is concentrated in the US and in a Kazakh state-owned processor that Sayari flags for regulatory action. The main people risk is to workers' lungs, not conflict.

steel.name: Specialty steels

security.text: The EU's reference fusion steel is made by very few qualified producers; F4E's 2015 order was forged by Saarschmiede with Böhler as subcontractor.

people.text: No human rights hotspot identified at this stage. Alloying inputs, including about 1% tungsten, were not traced.

sayari.name: Saarschmiede GmbH Freiformschmiede
sayari.basis: Registry: HRB 75004.

steel.bottomLine: Shown for contrast: a real bottleneck for building reactors, but not a human rights hotspot on current research. Its tungsten content links it back to the tungsten chain.
